name: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Quiver
summary: A faded writ requests a Heavy Quiver and gives details for delivery and payment. It can be transferred, but you need to carry it to complete the exchange.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: The note asks you to acquire the requested item and bring it to the location marked on your map. The writ must be with you for the transaction.

faq.answer: The customer requests one Heavy Quiver.
The delivery location is marked on your map.

faq.q: Do I need to carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have the writ with you to complete the transaction.

faq.q: Can I give this writ to someone else?
faq.answer: Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.
The note includes information about payment, but gives no amount in the text.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Heavy Quiver
